## What the data says

1. Sales totalled $2,297,201 and profit $286,397 (12.5% margin) across 5,009 orders and 9,994 line items.
2. Technology is the largest category at $836,154 (36.4% of sales) with a 17.4% margin.
3. West has the best profit margin (14.9%); Central has the lowest (7.9%).
4. Discounts of 40% or more cover 1,139 line items (10.7% of sales) and lose $-125,346.
5. Peak month was Nov 2017 ($118,448); Nov-Dec account for 29.5% of annual sales.
6. 1,871 line items (18.7% of all) are loss-making, totalling $-156,131.

## What to do next

1. Cap discounts in Tables: it lost $17,725 on $206,966 of sales.
2. Require approval for discounts of 40% or more (1,139 lines lose $125,346).
3. Grow Technology: it leads sales at 17.4% margin.

## Method notes

- High-discount flag threshold: 40% (tunable in src/02_clean.py).
- Negative profit is flagged, not removed: a loss is a business signal.
- Profit margin = profit / sales, guarded against zero sales.
- AOV = total sales / unique orders (an order can have many lines).
- Missing months are filled with zero so gaps stay visible.
- All figures in USD.
